TEXT:
In commemoration of our dating, the two of us 
went to a certain place.
A place that Kirino enjoys and loves...
A place filled with memories for both of us.
The date location I chose after anguishing over it is...

I’d have doubts about coming here if this were a 
normal date. But.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Game shops, game centers, book stores.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Hey, where should we start from?
A date like this just might be our style.
I hold out my right hand.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Let’s walk while holding hands. That kind of thing 
makes us seem like lovers, right?

Well, then again, this feeling might be more 
appropriate for lovers.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Did you forget about the first time we came here 
together?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Don’t stand so close to me. People will think we’re 
on a date.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: So something like that happened too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Do you still hate it if people think we’re on a date 
now?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Wait, you, that’s... not something you say to your 
boyfriend, you know?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I do hate it, but. Since it’s with you, I’ll hold hands.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
...For example, if you said that to hide your 
embarrassment, the other person might 
misunderstand you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Haah? What do you mean, hide my 
embarrassment? That’s not it at all.
It seems she really does hate it.

It's gradually becoming strange how we ended up 
dating.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ......From now on, I’m going to call you "Kyousuke".

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: That makes us seem more like lovers, right?
